Northside CNRA:
This program is based on an expanded Northside target area. (Refer to Figure #8)
N: Taylor Street - rear lot line, north side
E: Coyote Creek
S: Julian Street - rear lot line, south side
W: 7th Street - rear lot line, west side
--Loans and Grants
Loans and grants will be provided in the existing target area only, until the larger area receives California Housing Finance Agency (CHFA) designation. This action may not occur until the 5th year. There are 350 substandard units in the larger area. The plan would provide for improvement of 101 houses, leaving 249 substandard houses at the end of the 6th year.
Lower interest loans for home purchase and refinancing with rehabilitation are also available in this area through the Neighborhood Preservation Program of the California Housing Finance Agency. CDBG funds will be used to subsidize the rehabilitation portion of some CHFA loans in the Northside area.
--Sidewalk Repair
This project would provide for repair of sidewalks and curbs throughout the neighborhood revitalization area.
--Backesto Park
This project will provide $200,000 for additional special facilities such as apparatus areas, tennis court improvements and other features which will be formulated in the citizen master planning process in the spring of 1978. These projects are in addition to the $290,000 (78-79) which is scheduled for the basic renovation of the park.
Construction of a PAR physical fitness course is also recommended for Backesto Park.
A building is planned at Backesto Park, subject to citizen approval in the Park Master Planning process. The building would probably be a shelter building of about 1500 square feet on the 15th Street side of the park.
--Northside Community Center Expansion
Expansion of the center will involve enclosing the existing roof overhang areas at an approximate cost of $50,000.
